description: The Legaspi Place is a residential condominium development located in Legaspi Village, Makati City. Its location provides residents with convenient access to Makati's business and lifestyle destinations while maintaining a comfortable residential environment.

Designed for professionals, couples, families, and property investors, The Legaspi Place offers a selection of residential units supported by essential building facilities and amenities. Its strategic location makes it suitable for residents who value accessibility, convenience, and urban living.
The project can also serve as a practical investment option for buyers looking for a residential property within Makati's established business and commercial environment.

description: Grand Verdant Residences is a luxury residential condominium designed for residents who want to experience modern city living without giving up the comfort of green spaces. Located in Bonifacio Global City, the project provides convenient access to offices, shopping destinations, restaurants, schools, and entertainment establishments.
The development combines contemporary architecture, thoughtfully planned residential units, landscaped areas, and premium amenities to create a comfortable urban lifestyle.

description: Harbor Point Residences is a high-rise residential condominium designed for individuals and families who appreciate modern living with convenient access to the city and bay area. Its location along Roxas Boulevard provides residents with access to commercial establishments, entertainment destinations, transportation routes, and nearby business districts.
The project combines contemporary residential design with lifestyle amenities and selected spaces that allow residents to enjoy a relaxing urban environment.
